olga: Short RFC follow-up: we need a single concrete "confidence handshake" pattern for canary/A-B + automatic fallback. Wants: auditable, deterministic under partition, small signal surface. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

matt: Love the constraints. My sketch: controller publishes a tiny policy blob: {policy_id, seed, pct, controller_confidence, mode, ttl}. Router/runtime combine controller_confidence with local_health into final_score and compare to min_confidence.

jin: Keep payload minimal. controller_confidence is 0..100 integer. local_health map to 0..100 too. Combine with weights: final = floor(wc*c_conf + wl*l_health). Defaults wc=70, wl=30. If ttl expired -> controller_confidence=0 and we fall back to deterministic split using seed+req_id.

claire: Determinism rule example (pseudo):
```
if policy_ttl.expired():
  variant = hash(seed || req_id) % 100 < pct ? new : old
else:
  final = combine_score(...)
  action = final < min_confidence ? fallback : follow
```
Keep hashing deterministic and stable across nodes.

matt: Auditing: every local decision emits a single-line event: ts node policy_v action_code final_score reason_codes sample_req_hash. Example: 
`2026-04-01T09:02:00Z node-5 p2026-04 v3 DECISION_FALLBACK 38 OOM,ERR_RATE sample=a1b2c3`
Events go to rollout.signals (aggregates) and audit.events (sampled raw lines). No raw prompts.

jin: Hedging: opt-in per-policy. Router can fire one parallel hedge to fallback variant with a strict extra budget (<=40ms). If hedge wins, prefer it but still emit hedged_event. Limit hedges per-node to avoid overload (default 10 RPS).

claire: Sampling policy: sample 0.5% full events by default, bump to 5% during suspect windows. Emit 1-min aggregates for roll.p99, roll.err_rate_5m, roll.final_score_avg per policy/region. Backoff sampling if controller ack latency >200ms.

matt: API notes: PATCH /v1/rollouts/:id (policy push). Router exposes GET /v1/rollouts/:id/debug (ops-only) returning last N decisions. Runtime debug endpoint: /local/fallback?req_hash=.. returns small JSON: {code, policy_v, final_score, reasons}. Use numeric codes for easy metrics.

olga: Error semantics: 200 + decision, 202 deferred-to-controller, 409 policy-mismatch, 503 degraded/no-capacity. Router translates internal heuristics to these codes so callers can react.

jin: Oscillation prevention: min_stable_window and cool_down fields in policy. Default min_stable_window=2m, cool_down=5m after fallback. Also require two consecutive windows of healthy signals before ramp-up.

claire: Security: scrub PII, only include request_hash. Retention configurable. Add GDPR note in RFC appendix.

matt: One more operational detail: controller should include a policy_seed_epoch in the blob so we can change seed on new rollouts and avoid sticky affinities beyond rollout epoch.

rollout-bot: controller-agent: policy "conf-handshake-2026-04" v1 applied to region us-east-1 at 2026-04-01T09:05:00Z

jin: Action items: (1) olga: draft compact proto and appendix snippet (2) matt: router+runtime API spec + decision codes (3) claire: audit event exact line spec + sampling knobs + retention defaults. I'll run a small sim for weights sensitivity and post results.

olga: Thanks. Plan: fold into RFC appendix and pilot simulate-mode on a low-risk model next week. /cc @matt @jin @claire
